name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - SUPPLEMENTAL PACKET POSTED
agenda_text:
SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 28, 2026 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84070910557
  Webinar ID: 840 7091 0557
  One-tap Mobile:
  +16469313860,,84070910557# OR +13017158592,,84070910557#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 646 931 3860 OR +1 301 715 8592
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Honig, Davis, Pearl, Mayor Pro Tem Halpern,
  Mayor McSweeney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of January 14, 2026 City Council Study Session and January 14, 2026 Regular
Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  California Lutheran University “State of the University” presented by CLU
  President John Nunes, PhD.

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT – INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE
  NO. 312-26 AMENDING THE MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT THE SALE OF
  ALL KRATOM PRODUCTS WITHIN CITY LIMITS - Waive full reading and
  introduce Ordinance No. 312-26 amending the Municipal Code to prohibit the sale
  of all Kratom products in Westlake Village, approved a CEQA exemption and
  schedule the second reading for February 11, 2026.

  ORDINANCE NO. 312-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 5.1 TO
  PROHIBIT KRATOM PRODUCTS  AND APPROVING A CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  ALLOCATION OF FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027 COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM FUNDS; RESOLUTION NO. 2433-26 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2433-26.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2433-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING ALLOCATIONS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027
  FOR COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAMS

2.  OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 25-003; RESOLUTION NO. 2434-26 - Adopt Resolution
  No. 2434-26, determining Oak Tree Permit No. 25-003 is exempt from CEQA and
  to authorize the removal of one protected coast live oak tree and encroachment
  into the protected zones and pruning of three additional coast live oak trees located
  at 3520 Ridgeford Drive.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2434-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING OAK TREE PERMIT NO. 25-003,
  AUTHORIZING THE REMOVAL OF ONE COAST LIVE OAK TREE AND THE
  ENCROACHMENT INTO THE PROTECTED ZONES AND PRUNING OF THREE
  ADDITIONAL COAST LIVE OAK TREES IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE
  CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW, EXPANDED POOL LOCATED AT 3520 RIDGEFORD
  DRIVE

3.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 25-002; RESOLUTION NO. 2435-26 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2435-26, determining Conditional Use Permit No. 25-002 is exempt
  from CEQA and authorizing the conversion of an existing commercial space to a
  private training facility, located at 5740 Corsa Avenue.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2435-26: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 25-002, TO
  AUTHORIZE THE CONVERSION OF AN EXISTING COMMERCIAL SPACE INTO A
  PRIVATE TRAINING FACILITY LOCATED AT 5740 CORSA AVENUE (THE VILLAGE
  ATG)
 MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective January 15, 2026 in the amount
  of $460,226.96

  TREASURER’S REPORT: December 31, 2025

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO 311-26; ORDINANCE TITLE: AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE
  WESTLAKE  VILLAGE  MUNICIPAL CODE TO  ESTABLISH
  JUNETEENTH AS A CITY HOLIDAY - Waive the second reading and
  adopt Ordinance No. 311-26.

  ORDINANCE NO. 311-26: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE TO
  ESTABLISH JUNETEENTH AS A CITY HOLIDAY

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  UPDATE ON THE CITY’S STRATEGIES TO ADDRESS THE LONG-RANGE
  FINANCIAL FORECAST - Review the Council Committee updates in the report
  and give direction to staff as desired to help guide the work ahead.

2.  APPROVAL OF PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CIVIC
  SOLUTIONS, INC. TO PREPARE AN UPDATE TO THE HAZARDS CHAPTER
  OF THE GENERAL PLAN, INCLUDING A CITYWIDE EVACUATION
  ASSESSMENT – Authorize the Mayor to enter into a Professional Services
  Agreement with Civic Solutions, Inc. to prepare a citywide evacuation assessment
  and update to the Hazards Chapter of the General Plan; and, approve a budget
  amendment in the amount of $250,000 for contract costs.
 3.  CONSIDERATION OF CONTRACT TERMINATION FOR COMMUNITY PARK
  SIGNAGE PROJECT AND TRASH ENCLOSURE PROJECT WITH CINBAD
  INDUSTRY AND AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR COMMUNITY PARK SIGNAGE
  PROJECT TO BRAVO SIGN AND DESIGN INC. - Approve a compensation close-
  out agreement with Cinbad Industry, Inc. to terminate the construction contract for
  the Community Park Signage Project and the Trash Enclosure Project; award a
  construction contract for the Community Park Signage Project to Bravo Sign &
  Design, Inc. in the amount of $56,002.19; authorize the City Manager to approve
  change orders up to the contingency amount; and authorize the Mayor to sign and
  execute the contracts on behalf of the City.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, January 22, 2026 at 6:15 p.m. on the City’s website
and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  January 22, 2026
